bias.notes: BTC 30m BOS/OB primary; 1h only if 30m muddy. Often read 12:00–13:00 UK 1h candle (NY 7–8am).

steps: BTC in hourly OB or FVG (bias context)
Price reverses and creates a neck
Neck smashed with strong candle, ideally with FVG
Retest that FVG (or prior FVG) for entry
SOL must be doing the same; fire on SOL (needs less move for ~1% TP)
choke_definition.sl: high or low of the neck (right side of neck) → neck_extreme

align.rule: pair 3m MSS same window as BTC 3m; one FVG/acc enough
align.notes: BTC FVG+acc + SOL MSS-only is still a take on SOL. Acc must appear same time, not 5 candles after MSS. If 3m muddy, 2m can confirm.

window.london_note: London can already do the drop — dangerous; NY does the real move

tp_sl.sl_notes: If no FVG acc on SOL, SL to previous high/low (neck). Brake & Acceptance pack often uses past_sweep_wick + entry in acc range.

scenarios.1: In NY range (between prev NY high/low): BTC 1h/30m BOS picks root OB; wait return to root OB for direction
scenarios.2: Above prev NY high: bull OB created above high (night/London) = root; long when price returns with FVG acc
scenarios.3: Below prev NY low: bear OB under low + BOS down; wait NY return → short
scenarios.4: Retail trap: bull OB just under/near NY high (people think long) but root is fresh/older bear OB above → short
scenarios.5: Mirror trap under NY low: fake bear OB near low; root bull OB below → long
scenarios.6: Weekend: Friday NY OB only; mark Friday NY high/low; deny Sat/Sun fake BOS; alert to Friday OB

checklist_note: Short paper checklist mandatory — human nervous system loses recognition after ~1h of screen time (src-05/06/13).
